description: Policy-rate decisions in a date window, soonest first: decision day (local to the bank), announcement time in UTC where the bank publishes one, whether the date is on the bank's calendar, moved or unscheduled, the rate going in, and the decision once observed. Covers 21 central banks (Banco Central do Brasil, Bank Indonesia, Bank of Canada, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, Bank of Korea, Bank of Mexico, Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye, Czech National Bank, European Central Bank, Federal Reserve (Federal Open Market Committee), Magyar Nemzeti Bank, Narodowy Bank Polski, Norges Bank, People's Bank of China, Reserve Bank of Australia, Reserve Bank of India, Reserve Bank of New Zealand, South African Reserve Bank, Sveriges Riksbank, Swiss National Bank) and 2 inflation release series.

items.description: Bank id (e.g. "reserve-bank-of-india", "ecb", "cbrt"), name, common abbreviation (RBI, SNB, BoJ) or country

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD; default from + 60 days
